brief: Code point index of the first match of a regular expression
description: Searches string value for the regular expression and returns the code point index of the first match, or -1 if there is none, as ECMAScript's s.search(re) does. Use index_of to find literal text.

parameters.description: The regular expression. A regexp literal (/a+b/ or "a+b"re), to_regexp(s), or compile<regexp>(r) is already compiled; any other regexp value is compiled for this call.
parameters.name: regexp

returns.description: Zero-based code point index of the first match, or -1.
